description: A plan written to a file so that the same changes that were reviewed can be applied later.
The machine-readable form of a plan, with a resource_changes list that a policy can read.
A plan option that returns 0 for no changes, 1 for an error and 2 when changes are present.
Rules that read the changes of a plan and decide whether to approve it, require approval or reject it.
Two separate cloud identities, a read-only one for planning and a privileged one for applying.
The CloudFormation form of a plan, which lists the changes of an update and waits for an explicit execution.
